messages:
maya: Quick sync — how should we represent 'routing fallback' vs 'quota enforced' in the Console and in the API surface? Trying to avoid duplicate red banners.
jared: i'd keep 'quota' and 'routing' as orthogonal badges. quota -> yellow "Quota", routing fallback -> orange "Degraded route". :thinking_face:
linh: +1 for separate badges. ALSO need consistent HTTP mapping. Propose: 429 + X-Quota-Reason header, 503 for infra/unhealthy, 200+X-Fallback when we return a lower-capacity model.
sofia: 200 + fallback header feels risky for clients that expect model-level guarantees. prefer explicit 207 or 503 with a subcode like 503.100 'fallback-variant' so SDKs treat it as a distinct condition.
jared: SDKs currently treat non-2xx as errors. If we use 200 for fallback, many SDKs won't expose fallback metadata. That argues for non-2xx to ensure visibility.
maya: heads-up from ops: incident-bot flagged an uptick in 200-fallbacks earlier today (cc @ops-bot).
ops-bot: [bot] Alert: high rate of fallback-variant responses in us-west-2 — see runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fallbacks
linh: telemetry-wise we need tags: route_policy=(best_effort|strict), fallback_variant=(true|variant-name), quota_reason=(burst|hardcap). these should be top-level span tags and emitted to logs/metrics.
sofia: For Console UX: show a single request row with small badges + hover that explains routing decisions and provides link to the trace. Add an expandable "why" panel showing route history for that request.
maya: rollout plan: canary 5% tenants with new badges + SDK 3.2.0 that surfaces X-Fallback headers. If a tenant doesn't upgrade SDK, gateway will return 503+subcode to force visibility.
jared: follow-ups: (1) update status-mapping doc, (2) add telemetry tags in tracing, (3) coordinate SDK change. I can take (3).
maya: perfect. I'll PR mapping doc with a proposed table of HTTP codes -> console badge -> SDK surface. tagging owners: @jared @linh @sofia. :thumbsup:
sofia: ACK — will sketch console mockups by EOD Fri.
linh: I'll open telemetry PR after the mapping doc lands.
maya: thanks everyone — sync at next eng-platform stand if anything blocks.
